Example: Stock Average calculation

Using these inputs:

  • Asset class: Stocks
  • Your purchases: 20 180; 15 150
  • Current price: $140
  • Fee per trade: $0
  • Next buy price: $140
  • Target average: $155

The calculator returns:

  • Average cost: $167.14 (per share)
  • Total quantity: 35 shares
  • Total invested: $5,850
  • Unrealized P/L: −$950.00 (−16.24%)
  • Break-even price: $167.14 (+19.39% from current)
  • To reach $155.00 avg: Buy 29 shares (≈ $4,060 at $140.00)
